title: Inbox message
description: One append-only message inside an inbox thread. Structure lives only on the action boundary; a message carries free text plus optional typed annotations.

seq.description: Monotonic position inside the thread, starting at 1.

role.description: Who authored the message. system messages are written by the runtime, never by the agent.

text.description: The verbatim message text. Never rewritten or classified.

actor.description: Concrete author identity: the service user for sela, the login user id for human, 'runtime' for system.

suggested_replies.description: Only sela messages may carry these. Clicking one only fills the reply box; it never sends by itself.

refs.description: Links from the message to Trosa objects such as the prospect, an action receipt, a quoted message or a file.

hints.description: Optional preprocessing annotation. It is a hint only and never a gate: the agent always reads text verbatim.

attachments.description: File objects referenced by this message. Bytes live in core.file_objects, not here.

awaiting_after.description: Thread awaiting value derived from this message.

idempotency_key.description: Client supplied key. Replaying the same key in the same thread returns the stored message.
